ayahs.ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.en: By the mount
ayahs.e2: By Mount Ṭûr
ayahs.tr: Wat-Toor

ayahs.ar: وَكِتَٰبࣲ مَّسۡطُورࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And [by] a Book inscribed
ayahs.e2: And by the Book written
ayahs.tr: Wa kitaabim mastoor

ayahs.ar: فِي رَقࣲّ مَّنشُورࣲ‏
ayahs.en: In parchment spread open
ayahs.e2: on open pages ˹for all to read˺
ayahs.tr: Fee raqqim manshoor

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
ayahs.en: And [by] the frequented House
ayahs.e2: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited
ayahs.tr: Wal baitil ma'moor

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
ayahs.en: And [by] the heaven raised high
ayahs.e2: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺
ayahs.tr: Wassaqfil marfoo

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
ayahs.en: And [by] the sea filled [with fire]
ayahs.e2: And by the seas set on fire
ayahs.tr: Wal bahril masjoor

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—
ayahs.tr: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Of it there is no preventer
ayahs.e2: none will avert it—
ayahs.tr: Maa lahoo min daafi

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.e2: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently
ayahs.tr: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa

ayahs.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing
ayahs.e2: and the mountains will be blown away entirely
ayahs.tr: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa

ayahs.ar: فَوَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.e2: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—
ayahs.tr: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضࣲ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves
ayahs.e2: those who amuse themselves with falsehood
ayahs.tr: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say]
ayahs.e2: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell
ayahs.tr: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.en: This is the Fire which you used to deny
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny
ayahs.tr: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

ayahs.ar: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see
ayahs.e2: Is this magic, or do you not see
ayahs.tr: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon

ayahs.ar: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do
ayahs.e2: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”
ayahs.tr: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem

ayahs.ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.e2: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire
ayahs.tr: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem

ayahs.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
ayahs.tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.e2: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes
ayahs.tr: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained
ayahs.e2: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

ayahs.ar: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ وَلَحۡمࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
ayahs.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire
ayahs.e2: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire
ayahs.tr: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon

ayahs.ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin
ayahs.e2: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness
ayahs.tr: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem

ayahs.ar: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected
ayahs.e2: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls
ayahs.tr: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon

ayahs.ar: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other
ayahs.e2: They will turn to one another inquisitively
ayahs.tr: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah]
ayahs.e2: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen

ayahs.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.en: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire
ayahs.e2: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat
ayahs.tr: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful
ayahs.e2: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”
ayahs.tr: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
ayahs.en: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman
ayahs.e2: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman
ayahs.tr: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
ayahs.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time
ayahs.e2: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters
ayahs.e2: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”
ayahs.tr: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people
ayahs.e2: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people
ayahs.tr: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe
ayahs.e2: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful
ayahs.e2: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true
ayahs.tr: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]
ayahs.e2: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators
ayahs.tr: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain
ayahs.e2: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]
ayahs.e2: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺
ayahs.tr: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority
ayahs.e2: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof
ayahs.tr: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
ayahs.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons
ayahs.e2: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons
ayahs.tr: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down
ayahs.e2: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
ayahs.tr: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down
ayahs.e2: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺
ayahs.tr: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan
ayahs.e2: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes
ayahs.tr: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him
ayahs.e2: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺
ayahs.tr: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up
ayahs.e2: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”
ayahs.tr: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
ayahs.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible
ayahs.e2: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—
ayahs.tr: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped
ayahs.e2: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped
ayahs.tr: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know
ayahs.e2: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know
ayahs.tr: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise
ayahs.e2: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise
ayahs.tr: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars
ayahs.e2: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars
ayahs.tr: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom
